title: GeoPackage rebuild digest changed because GDAL stamped current gpkg_contents.last_change values
symptom: Two semantically identical builds initially produced different .gpkg SHA-256 values.
expected_behavior: A source-identical archival build should produce stable bytes when the producer supports deterministic timestamp control.
actual_behavior: gpkg_contents.last_change used wall-clock timestamps; identical layer content therefore changed container bytes.
proposed_fix: Use GDAL's existing OGR_CURRENT_DATE configuration rather than post-editing GeoPackage internals.
fix_attempt: build.sh now exports OGR_CURRENT_DATE=2026-09-15T00:00:00.000Z before all ogr2ogr writes.
verification: Two consecutive full build.sh runs produced the identical GeoPackage SHA-256 sha256:d92a8029524d1be7b7b480c8d152aec9379a07ae41df69c3fd3c9b49b3ce90a8.
